Reviewer: skull pool job review-4373, claude-fable-5-2, mkinney / claude-mike seat; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** This is a SAFETY-tier review, because the PR changes posted G-code (the header block of `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps`). This is the first review of this PR. I read the full diff.

Owner record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4373#issuecomment-7220443811

## What looks good

- `onOpen` writes the machine name through the `clean()` of the post. That helper is the same text as the helper in `fanuc.cps` and `fanuc-lathe.cps`.
- `oWord()` refuses a program number outside O0001-O9999. The message is the same as in `fanuc.cps`. The old clamp to `O9999` named another program.
- `oWord()` has one caller, `onOpen`. The refusal stops the post before a program is returned.
- `ProgramId.number` is a `u32`. Thus a negative number and a NaN cannot arrive from the engine. The `isNaN` arm is a guard only.
- The new pin asserts the cleaned header, the count of `%`, the O9999 limit and the two refusals (0 and 10000).
- `docs/decisions/4349-dnm-header-name-onumber.md` records the choice and the dropped options.
- The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #4349`. The commit subject is conventional.

## Results, merged with main

Built locally, in `.claude/worktrees/review-4373`. The tree is the PR head `526dda36e` merged with upstream/main `4da7b3f58`. The merge was clean (`assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps` merged automatically with #4348).

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post --test comment_escape --test doosan_dnm_post --test script_doosan_dnm` | 5 + 9 + 11 passed |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 73 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The quick gate included these golden suites, all green: `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`, `conformance`, `doosan_dnm_a_state`, `first_part_programs`, `first_4axis_part`, `continuous_4axis_part`, and `post suites: script_doosan_dnm`, `doosan_dnm_post`, `fanuc_post`.

Note: the shared sccache server on this host did not answer. I built without the compile cache (`CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`). This does not change the result.

## Mutations (I ran them again)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `clean(nm)` back to `nm` in `onOpen` | red: the new pin fails with `left: Some("O0001 (DNM 5700 (5AX) 100%)")`; `hostile_names_post_well_formed_comments_in_every_mill_dialect` fails with `doosan-dnm: unbalanced or nested comment "O0001 (MSG, Mill (A); B*)"` |
| Upper bound removed from the guard (`n < 1` only) | red: the new pin fails with `program number 10000 must be refused` |
| Fix restored | green (the quick gate above) |

## Goldens moved

None. The diff has three files: the post, the test, the decision record. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changed. The catalog and conformance suites pass without a change, which agrees with the body.

## Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff changes no file under `testdata/` and no golden directory. No extra suite is owed.
- Importers: the diff does not touch the import code. No extra suite is owed.

## Heavy lanes

Not run. There is no heavy record for this head. The body reports `cargo xtask gate heavy` green (2 steps) by the author. The heavy lanes are not a merge condition.

## Law check

- Prime Directive: the change replaces a silent wrong O-number with a refusal by name. No new panic path in product code.
- Code shape: `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs` is 353 lines. The post script is exempt from the length rule.
- Testing: the pin is in `crates/post/tests/`, the crate that owns the engine.
- Clean-room: the source that the comment names is the published FANUC operator's manual. No Autodesk material.
- No process file, snapshot PNG, dependency, `build.rs`, `scripts/` or `.github/` change. No `crates/ui` change, thus no screenshots are necessary.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:754`: a machine name that has only `(`, `)`, `%` or `;` is cleaned to an empty text, and the header is `O0001 ()`. `fanuc.cps:652` has a fallback (`clean(nm) || "CAMCRAFT"`). An empty comment is legal, so this is not a defect. A fallback `clean(nm) || "DOOSAN DNM"` makes the two posts agree.
2. `crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs:11`: the Gate map comment says "the seven assets/posts/*.cps". The list is longer now.
3. No test pins the cut to 40 characters for this post. The body says so under "Not exercised".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
